About the model

Street grid, shoreline, islands and 45 landmark heights follow the real city (CN Tower 553 m, SkyTower 352 m, First Canadian Place 298 m). Other buildings are generated to match each district's density. Sun position and clock are live; traffic is a visual simulation.
